customManagers.description: Renovate-annotated HuggingFace revision pins in ansible/roles/llm_model_catalog/defaults/main.yml. A HuggingFace model repo is a plain git repository, so this tracks each pinned commit against the git-refs datasource (packageName = the repo's own HF URL) rather than a custom datasource. Uses its own `# renovate-digest:` prefix, distinct from this estate's shared `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` annotation (dryvist/.github's renovate-presets.json): that shared manager's regex has no packageName group and would otherwise also match this same line, trying (and failing) to resolve git-refs against a packageName of just the model's short name instead of its HuggingFace URL.
